uses.quote: It’s important you use generative artificial intelligence (AI) carefully and always disclose how you’ve used it in your assessments.
uses.anchor: How am I allowed to use AI in my work?

uses.quote: Is it okay to copy others’ work or use generative AI to produce it? It’s never the right course of action to ignore or not apply the principles of academic integrity. Doing so is unacceptable and will be defined as academic misconduct
